name: Matz Equipment - Automotive Lifts Parts & Accessories
old_description: Matz Equipment was founded with one mission — to provide dependable service and repair for automotive and industrial equipment. Over the years, we’ve grown into a trusted partner for businesses and individuals, offering everything from routine maintenance to complex mechanical overhauls. With skilled technicians and a customer-first approach, we make sure every job is done right the first time.
about:
Matz Equipment was founded in 1992 in Bridgeport, West Virginia, as a family-owned business with a mission to provide dependable service and repair for automotive and industrial equipment. The company began as a one-call solution for shop equipment needs, focusing on honest, reliable workmanship.

The firm specializes in installation, inspection, maintenance, and repair of vehicle lifts (including scissor, two-post, four-post, in-ground, and motorcycle lifts), alignment systems, lube systems, and air compressors. It also supplies parts and accessories through relationships with top U.S. lift manufacturers, operating with a small team of dedicated technicians who handle most service calls within days.

Customers span commercial automotive dealers, motorcycle and ATV shops, tire and body shops, antique car collectors, oil and gas firms, environmental and industrial companies, as well as municipal, county, state, and military facilities across the Mid-Atlantic region.

The company emphasizes a customer-first approach, quick response times, and competitive pricing enabled by its regional location and supplier network. Its inspectors undergo rigorous training to certify lifts with an inspection certificate, aiming to reduce downtime and long-term maintenance costs for clients.
